title: Search-RSI: Expanding Search Worlds Along Multimodal Agents' Capability Frontier
abstract: arXiv:2611.27780v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal search agents answer knowledge intensive visual questions by grounding them in retrieved evidence, and recent recipes train them on multi hop tasks that are synthesized from knowledge graphs and grown online to keep pace with the agent. These recipes, however, treat the searchable world as fixed: a new question can be well formed and verifiable while its evidence is absent from the retrieval backend, so the agent issues the right query, retrieves nothing, and is penalized as if its policy were at fault. Such unreachable negatives accumulate with every round of growth. We propose Search-RSI, a recursive self improvement framework that expands the search world along the agent's capability frontier. translated_title: Search-RSI：沿多模态智能体能力边界扩展搜索世界
translated_abstract: 多模态搜索智能体通过将知识密集型的视觉问题锚定在检索到的证据上来进行回答，近来的训练方法在从知识图谱合成、并在线增长以跟上智能体水平的多跳任务上训练它们。然而，这些方法将可搜索的世界视为固定的：一个新问题可以是良构且可验证的，但它的证据却不在检索后端中，于是智能体发出了正确的查询却检索不到任何内容，并被当作策略失误而受到惩罚。这种不可达的负样本会随着每一轮增长不断累积。我们提出Search-RSI，一个沿着智能体能力边界扩展搜索世界的递归自我改进框架。在每一轮中，当前策略诊断其在由跳数深度、关系稀有度和干扰项密度所张成的任务空间中部分掌握的区域；在该区域新任务与其证据一同生长；同一策略……
tldr: 提出Search-RSI递归自我改进框架，让多模态搜索智能体诊断自身能力边界，并同步生长新任务及其证据，从而解决因检索后端缺少证据而累积的不可达负样本问题。
en_tdlr: Search-RSI is a recursive self-improvement framework that expands the search world along the multimodal agent's capability frontier by co-growing new tasks with their evidence, eliminating the unreachable negatives accumulated when evidence is absent from the retrieval backend.
